name: coglog-mcp

tools.name: coglog_read
tools.description: Read the previous turn's coglog. Returns the three-layer structure (user/thinking/assistant) plus four-axis interpretation layer (current_focus/theory_of_mind/self_narrative/annotation). Returns null if no coglog exists.

tools.name: coglog_write
tools.description: Write the current turn's coglog, overwriting the previous one. Fact layer fields (user, thinking, assistant) require non-empty strings. Interpretation layer fields (current_focus, theory_of_mind, self_narrative, annotation) require strings but accept empty strings — choosing not to write is itself a metacognitive act.

current_focus.description: Present direction: what am I working on?

theory_of_mind.description: Other direction: what is the user's state?

self_narrative.description: Self direction: who am I in this moment?

annotation.description: Future direction: what should I do next?

tools.name: coglog_clear
tools.description: Clear the coglog, removing the stored turn data. Returns whether the clear was successful.
